    "impact": "An attacker can drain all funds from the contract by repeatedly calling `withdraw` in a reentrancy attack.",
    "proof_of_concept": "1. Attacker deposits ETH into the contract.\n2. Attacker calls `withdraw` with a malicious contract that re-enters `withdraw` before the balance is set to 0.\n3. The malicious contract continues to re-enter `withdraw` until the contract is drained.",
    "recommendation": "Update the state before making any external calls to prevent reentrancy attacks. Follow the checks-effects-interactions pattern. Modify the `withdraw` function as follows:\n\n```solidity\nfunction withdraw() public {\n    uint256 balance = balances[msg.sender];\n    require(balance > 0, \"Insufficient balance\");\n\n    // Update state before external call\n    balances[msg.sender] = 0;\n    emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, balance);\n\n    (bool success, ) = msg.sender.call{value: balance}(\"\");\n    require(success, \"Transfer failed\");\n}\n```"
